events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away on this day in 1991, leaving an indelible mark on music.

angles.name: Queen's legacy
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his sheer talent... unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal shift in their sound.

angles.name: Revolutionary album
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul' and changed the game. A masterpiece of songwriting and innovation. What's your go-to track from the album?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was tragically killed on this day in 1980, he would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring message
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86. His music and message of peace continue to resonate. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, the influential 'Starman' of music, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: The Thin White Duke
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. A true innovator and legend. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
